nodes.message:
fix: make the Story graph readable on phones

On a 390px phone the graph settled into a round blob that filled only the middle of a tall screen, so it fitted small and its centre labels piled on top of each other. The layout now re-settles for tall views with a stronger sideways pull so it fills the screen's height, and labels that would overlap are hidden, keeping highlighted and bigger entries first. Wide desktop views lay out exactly as before.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
nodes.messageHeadline: fix: make the Story graph readable on phones

nodes.message:
feat: interactive force-directed Story connection graph

The old graph was a fixed ring of circles that got unreadable past a
handful of entries. The new view lays entries out with a small
force simulation (no new dependency), sizes nodes by connections,
colours them by entry type, and shows wiki links dashed. It can be
panned, zoomed (wheel, buttons, pinch), nodes can be dragged, hover
highlights a node's neighbours and a search box focuses a node.
Linked non-story assets can be toggled on as smaller outlined nodes.

The layout, graph building and camera maths live in src/lib so they
are unit tested; the view is split into src/components/story.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
nodes.messageHeadline: feat: interactive force-directed Story connection graph

nodes.message:
feat: polish the Canvas example boards and add a core-loop board

The example boards had cards floating outside their sections, edge labels
squeezed into gaps and only a slice of what the canvas can do. Every board
now has a clear purpose, sections on a consistent grid and a mix of cards:
real project assets, video and song links, sticky notes, to-do lists and
freehand pen strokes.

- Moodboard: look, sound and game-feel sections; a hand-drawn jump arc
  shows full jump vs short hop next to the GMTK Celeste video.
- Level plan: three beats plus a marked-up side-view sketch (red pen over
  the coin jump and the flag) and a "Build it" section with the tilemap,
  story entry and to-do list.
- New "Pip's Core Loop": a flow chart using every flow and basic shape,
  each step wired to the asset behind it, with the fun bit circled.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
nodes.messageHeadline: feat: polish the Canvas example boards and add a core-loop board

nodes.message:
Prerender the page and add structured data, sitemap and social tags

The build now renders the page to HTML, so crawlers and link previews see all
of it and the browser hydrates it. The prerender step adds JSON-LD for the
site, the app and the FAQ, and writes a dated sitemap. Closed FAQ answers and
inactive tabs stay in the page, hidden, so their text is in the HTML too.

The head gets a keyword-led title and description, robots, Open Graph and
Twitter tags with image size and alt text, and a web manifest. Also adds
robots.txt, llms.txt, 192 and 512 px icons, and a branded 1200x630 og.jpg.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01VM59ghZ8JBgbMzVjERoDbt
